label: NOT HISTORICALLY VALIDATED
summary: The evidence does not support an advantage over the benchmarks: price history exists for only 78% of eligible test-period IPOs, so results describe survivors of the price vendor's database, not all IPOs; BUY recommendations underperformed SPY over 12 months: -25.3% [-36.5%, -10.5%]. BUY recommendations did lose less than buying every eligible IPO (difference 9.3% [3.1%, 18.1%]), but a smaller loss is not an advantage over the market, and the walk-forward difference is 3.2% [-2.1%, 8.9%].

criteria.name: H1 — BUY trades beat SPY over 12 months (95% interval above zero)
H2 — BUY trades beat buying every eligible IPO (95% interval above zero)
H3 — Brier score better than the base rate
Guardrail 1 — at least 30 BUY trades over at least 8 entry quarters
Guardrail 2 — still positive without the best 5% of BUY trades
Guardrail 3 — still positive at 50 bps per side
Guardrail 4 — price history for at least 90% of eligible test-period IPOs
Test period was held out (never unsealed with other rules)
